title: Regime-Dependent Validity in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Evidence from SPARC Galaxy Rotation Curves and the EFC-R Framework
abstract: Pilot-scale empirical test of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) on 20 SPARC galaxies spanning LSB, dwarf irregular, spiral, and barred/disturbed morphologies. The study finds regime-dependent validity—EFC excels in low-complexity systems (LSB, diffuse dwarfs) and underperforms in structurally complex galaxies—motivating the EFC-R meta-framework with the decomposition E_total = E_flow + E_latent.
